item.title: Discoveries-through-Prose
item.content:encoded:
This call invites authors to submit manuscripts using nontraditional formats through the Discoveries-through-Prose initiative. The format is designed to help authors develop manuscripts that are more concise and engaging by departing from conventional structural approaches.

Appel publié par Academy of Management Discoveries. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Nontraditional manuscript formats
  • Engaging narratives
  • Tight narrative construction

item.title: Registered Reports
item.content:encoded:
This call invites scholars to submit registered reports to AMD, a submission format for completed or planned studies where authors present their introduction, methods, measurement information, and analysis plan without results. The evaluation focuses on the significance of the research question, the validity of the analytical approach, methodological quality, and potential contributions to theory and practice.

By separating the evaluation from outcomes, registered reports align with the journal's commitment to publishing studies with null or negligible findings, ensuring that results do not influence editorial decisions.

Appel publié par Academy of Management Discoveries. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Studies with important theoretical or practical implications regardless of results
  • Research with rigorous methodological design
  • Studies with potential impact on future theorizing and practice/policy

Timeline

  • January 1, 2025: Submission window opens
  • December 31, 2026: Submission window closes
